description: This file defines the HTTP_Session_Container class used for managing session data in a PHP application, including session lifecycle methods and handler setup.

classes.name: HTTP_Session_Container
classes.description: A class responsible for managing session data storage, providing methods to open, close, read, write, and delete sessions, as well as garbage collection.

methods.name: HTTP_Session_Container
methods.description: Constructor method initializing defaults and parsing options.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default options for the container.

methods.name: _parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and assigns options passed to the container.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes session storage; called by session handler.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes session handling; called when session ends.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data for a given session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores session data for a given session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data for a given session ID.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Copies session data to another table or location.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to delete old sessions.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Registers this container as the session handler.
